description: Which organic TikTok posts are worth running as Spark Ads: TikTok rates the connected account’s posts HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW, optionally for an objective (REACH, TRAFFIC, VIDEO_VIEWS, ENGAGEMENT, APP_PROMOTION, LEAD_GENERATION, WEB_CONVERSIONS, PRODUCT_SALES) and period (PAST_ONE_MONTH / THREE / SIX). Pass ttoAccountId to rate TikTok One creator-marketplace posts instead. Read-only, free.

excludeVideoIds.description: post ids to leave out of the ratings

objective.description: campaign objective to rate posts for, e.g. REACH, TRAFFIC or VIDEO_VIEWS; omit for all

ttoAccountId.description: rate TikTok One creator posts instead of your own

name: tiktok_spark_recommendations
title: Which TikTok posts to boost
